InsightFace pretrained model weights — terms of use
====================================================

Bundled file: models/w600k_mbf.onnx (MobileFaceNet recognition weights,
distributed upstream inside buffalo_sc.zip).

Source (pinned): https://github.com/deepinsight/insightface/releases/download/v0.7/buffalo_sc.zip
Terms source (pinned): https://github.com/deepinsight/insightface/blob/v0.7/README.md

THIS FILE CARRIES NO LICENSE GRANT FROM THIS PROJECT. The upstream project's
"License" section at the pinned tag states, verbatim:

    The code of InsightFace is released under the MIT License. There is no limitation for both academic and commercial usage.

    The training data containing the annotation (and the models trained with these data) are available for non-commercial research purposes only.

    Both manual-downloading models from our github repo and auto-downloading models with our [python-library](python-package) follow the above license policy(which is for non-commercial research purposes only).

The MIT license applies to InsightFace's source code only. The pretrained
weights bundled here are RESTRICTED to non-commercial research purposes. They
are not covered by this project's AGPL license, and no broader permission is
asserted or implied. Any use outside non-commercial research requires replacing
this file with differently-licensed weights or obtaining appropriate rights
from the upstream authors.
